tools.name: dns_truth_analyze_domain
tools.description: [$0.05 USDC/Solana per call] Passive DNS/domain truth report: nameservers, A/AAAA, MX, SPF, DMARC, DNSSEC plus certificate and deliverability signals. SSRF-safe, anonymous — no domain authorization required.

tools.name: blacksignal_run_canary
tools.description: [$0.10 USDC/Solana per call] BlackSignal release-breakage canary for an npm/PyPI package: analyzes the latest release (or an explicit range) for yanks, deprecations, major version bumps, tightened runtime requirements and dependency churn — with registry evidence.

tools.name: blacksignal_check_upgrade_safety
tools.description: [$0.05 USDC/Solana per call] Is this specific upgrade safe? Analyzes a package's from_version → to_version for breaking changes, with registry evidence. Cheaper than run_canary because the range is explicit.

tools.name: blacksignal_get_breakage_feed
tools.description: [$0.01 USDC/Solana per call] Evidence-backed public npm/PyPI breakage feed from BlackSignal platform monitors. Returns only platform-public incidents; private tenant monitor findings are never exposed.

tools.name: get_job_status
tools.description: Check the status/result of a paid job by its job_id (the settlement tx signature). Free.

tools.name: agent_catalog
tools.description: List the payable cells/tools, their prices, input schemas and endpoints. Free.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "dns_truth_analyze_domain" references sensitive artifacts (authorization). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.
